note: The IRDL projection (bcir.irdl.mlir) covers the structural subset of the dialect. IRDL admits only [a-z0-9_] operation names, so a dotted ODS name is spelled with underscores (gem.stream_pack -> gem_stream_pack): that is the projection's one naming deviation, applied as a rule by tools/irdl/check_inventory.py, never tabulated per operation. Every ODS operation is either projected under that rule or listed here with the reason it is not; the gate refuses an undeclared gap, a stale entry, a ghost, an orphan projection and a naming collision, and the quick tier runs it on every host (bcir/tests/test_irdl_inventory.py).

unprojected.asm: heterogeneous variadic operands (the outputs then the inputs, of any types): an IRDL constraint variable binds ONE type for a whole variadic group (irdl.any and irdl.any_of alike, checked on MLIR 23), so no IRDL spelling accepts `asm` as ODS defines it -- projecting it would refuse legitimate programs; the compiled bcir-opt rail verifies it
